note: rr software ticks in glibc's x86-64 assembly: glibc-101-rr-softticks-asm.patch (hand) and glibc-102-rr-softticks-loops.patch (the loops below). tick_line: the RR_SOFTTICK's line in the patched source; before: the source line it precedes; label: the loop's label; functions/objects: where that line is assembled.

hand.what: RR_SOFTTICK_ENTRY in ENTRY_P2ALIGN: every function ENTRY defines (string/memory/wide functions of every ISA, __mpn_*, setjmp/longjmp, the context functions, clone/vfork/syscall stubs, __tls_get_addr, _mcount/__fentry__, libm's .S, libmvec's .S, rtld's copies)
_start: no entry tick (runs once, before the countdown page is mapped in a static program)
entry ticks at the hand-written STRCMP labels (strcmp, strncmp, wcscmp, wcsncmp, strcasecmp_l, strncasecmp_l; avx2, avx2_rtm, evex, sse42)
__mpn_add_n, __mpn_sub_n: RR_SOFTTICK_CF (%al) before the jmp L(top) (CF live round the loop, %rax dead)
__memmove_ssse3 (memcpy, mempcpy, _chk): the 48 copy loops (loop_fwd_*, large_loop_fwd_*, loop_bkwd_*) tick at their tops, 128 bytes apart (LOOP_P2ALIGN/LOOP_SHIFT 7) for the computed jumps
